company_info.industry_info: Technology, Digital Publishing and Social Media Platform. Quora is a social Q&A community platform dedicated to growing the world's collective intelligence through question-and-answer interactions.
company_info.recent_news: Quora raised $75M in Series D funding on January 10, 2024. The company is actively hiring with 63 active job postings in 2026 (54.5% increase from 2025). Quora's headcount declined 19% from 969 employees in 2023 to 785 in 2026, but has since grown to approximately 1,176 as of June 2026.
company_info.company_culture: Quora has a transparent and collaborative culture with intelligent and kind coworkers. According to Glassdoor, Quora Inc. has an employee rating of 4.1 out of 5 stars with a culture rating of 4.3 out of 5. 87% of employees would recommend working at Quora to a friend. The company culture is rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation.
company_info.any_related_information: Quora was founded in 2009 and became a unicorn in 2017. The company is headquartered in Mountain View, California. Founded by Charlie Cheever and Adam D Angelo. The ML Platform (MLP) team has completed notable projects including 3x faster ML with 25% lower costs using NVIDIA Triton on Amazon EKS, building a service mesh in hybrid environments, and feature engineering advancements. The role offers strong mentorship with senior and staff engineers and opportunities to ship to production in the first few weeks despite being a new grad position.

required_skills_technologies: Knowledge of ML infrastructure and large-scale systems
nice_to_have_skills: Previous software engineering experience via internship, work experience, open-source contribution or coding competition
Coursework or hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow
Exposure to Kubernetes, Docker, or cloud technologies like AWS
Experience with low-level performance work: profiling, benchmarking, optimization

key_responsibilities: Help build and maintain core infrastructure powering Quora's ML platform ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance; Build and improve distributed systems serving ML models in production from Large Recommendation Models (LRM) to Large Language Models (LLM); Work on GPU model serving optimizing latency, throughput, and cost; Contribute to platform initiatives such as PyTorch-first standardization and ML ecosystem modernization; Improve ML developer velocity by building tooling for model development, testing, and deployment; Modernize feature store for faster feature deployment; Participate in on-call rotation for production issue resolution
